description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing app version data in a database, including methods for inserting, updating, retrieving, and deleting version records, with complex diffing and JSON handling logic.

classes.name: VersionDao
classes.description: Public interface defining methods for inserting and retrieving app version data.

classes.name: VersionDaoInt
classes.description: Internal interface extending VersionDao with transaction and diffing implementations for database operations.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts new versions for a package from a full index, checking compatibility.

methods.name: getAppVersions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of app versions, optionally filtered by repoId, sorted by version code.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Retrieves a specific version record by repoId, packageName, and versionId.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Retrieves multiple versions for a list of package names, handling large lists efficiently.

methods.name: getVersionsInternal
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve versions for a list of package names with specific query.

methods.name: diffVersion
methods.description: Diffs an existing version against a JSON object, ensuring internal fields are protected.

methods.name: diffVersionedStrings
methods.description: Diffs versioned strings like permissions based on JSON data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates versions based on a diff map, adding, modifying, or deleting as needed.

methods.name: deleteAppVersion
methods.description: Deletes all versions for a given package in a repo.

methods.name: deleteVersionedStrings
methods.description: Deletes versioned strings for a specific version.

methods.name: countAppVersions
methods.description: Returns the total count of app version records.

methods.name: countVersionedStrings
methods.description: Returns the total count of versioned string records.
